script: o=$(mktemp); kind(){ n=0; while IFS= read -r line; do n=$((n+1)); done < "$o"; echo rows=$n; }; set -m; /bin/true | /bin/sh -c 'kill -STOP $$; /bin/sleep 0.1; exit 7' & p=$!; /bin/sh -c 'while [ -e "/proc/$1/stat" ]; do read a b s r < "/proc/$1/stat"; [ "$s" = T ] && exit; done' sh "$p"; /bin/sleep 0.2; jobs >/dev/null; jobs -n > "$o" 2> "$o.err"; echo status=$?; kind; [ -s "$o.err" ] && echo warned; kill -CONT %1; wait -f %1; echo final=$?; rm -f "$o" "$o.err"
